ASSESSMENT: IranIran has maintained a uranium enrichment program for decades. Uranium enrichment can produce both low-enriched uranium, which can be used in nuclear power reactors, and highly enriched uranium (HEU), which is one of the two types of fissile material used in nuclear weapons. Tehran asserts its enrichment program is only meant to produce fuel for peaceful nuclear applications.

The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) withdrew inspectors from Iran in June 2025 after U.S.-Israeli airstrikes on Iranian nuclear facilities. The extent to which those strikes strikes impacted Iran's enrichment program is unclear.
